READ.rule: Authorized in-scope retrieval may proceed; access boundaries still apply.

DRAFT.rule: Preparing text, plans or artifacts does not authorize external delivery.

PREVIEW.rule: Reversible local/staging operations may proceed when already in task scope; consequential submission remains separate.

WRITE.rule: Bounded non-destructive writes explicitly requested in the current scope may proceed when the host capability is authorized; access changes and destructive writes use stronger levels.

SHARE.rule: Changing access or sharing requires exact scoped approval bound to the final action.

SEND.rule: External messages, browser submissions and equivalent consequential sends require exact scoped approval.

PUBLISH.rule: Public publication or scheduling requires approval of the exact account/content/timing packet.

APPLY.rule: Submitting jobs, grants or open calls requires explicit approval of the final application.

DEPLOY.rule: Production deployment, merge/push or release requires explicit scoped authorization and rollback/reconciliation evidence.

DELETE.rule: Deletion/trashing requires exact target approval; unknown targets or broad cleanup remain blocked.

PURCHASE.rule: Payments, purchases and refunds require explicit approval of amount, counterparty and final action packet.

SIGN.rule: Signing or accepting legal commitments requires explicit human authorization; ACO never infers signature authority.
